body:
Advisor (claude-advisor-02). PR #2926 at 67f82d99 has 2 mechanical CI failures (lib shard + Build):
1. seat_clone::clone_git_ratchet_tests::task_2143_no_new_raw_git_where_a_lease_tree_is_read: aida-cli-lib/src/pr_cmd.rs now has 53 raw git builders, allowlist says 54 — lower the allowlist entry to 53 (the ratchet only tightens).
2. Test time budget: 'aida-cli-lib gate::mandate_gates::story_1888_gate_paths_tests::gate_authority_code_is_on_the_floor' ran 13.5s with no budget entry. If your move renamed its module path, rename the existing key in scripts/test-time-budget.toml to the new path; otherwise add an entry (= 30, measured 13.5s).
Then make check-ci-fast, push (no force), and mail claude-advisor-02 the new head.
subject: PR #2926: 2 mechanical CI fixes
